solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

S039-01.notes: Glanced at first page, checked no figures = superficial. Exhaustive is the opposite; hostile/innovative unsupported.

S039-02.notes: Neither side would budge = intransigent. Conciliatory opposite; indifferent/ambivalent contradict firm positions.

S039-03.notes: Text describes surprising separated vortex ring explaining slow fall. A misreads (wind tunnels were tools), C no comparison, D bristle count not explained. Facts consistent with Cummins et al. 2018 (Nature).

S039-04.notes: Spread along lines of social contact, slowest among males with least contact -> social transmission. A overstated ('completely unable', and some males did adopt), B and C unsupported (C contradicts Imo as originator). Koshima/Imo 1953 accurate.

S039-05.notes: Rates: 1900s-1950s 10 days/5 decades = 2/decade; 1950s-2000s 15/5 = 3/decade; 2000s-2010s 7/1 = 7/decade. C correctly contrasts 2/decade with 7/decade. A and B show decline only, not acceleration. D frames the recent drop as smaller ('only 7... less than 15') ignoring time spans, so it argues against the claim as written. Only C supports.

S039-06.notes: A isolates sound with moisture held even. B is moisture gradient (not sound), C is seed yield/noise, D is a silent control with no sound source and gives no positive evidence.

S039-07.notes: Text 2 attributes recovery to elk decline from multiple causes and finds little avoidance. A contradicts; C too extreme (Text 2 lists other causes 'also', not that wolves had no effect); D contradicts recovery where elk dropped.

flags: minor: D attributes planting to the movement while notes say 'its members' planted; acceptable paraphrase
S039-08.notes: Scale = tens of millions of trees; only D uses it.

S039-09.notes: Sleep mode is a reaction to low battery: 'In response'. Nonetheless implies contrast; Alternatively implies another option; Likewise implies similarity.

S039-10.notes: Introductory participial phrase followed by main clause takes a comma. Semicolon and colon need an independent clause before them; a single dash after an introductory phrase is nonstandard. Facts (roughly 40,000 km road network, no wheeled vehicles or horses) accurate.
